futurescapes.name: Worldwide IT Industry
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry 2018 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Table of contents read from an Internet Archive copy.

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda 2018 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Read from a trade-press copy (InfotechLead, November 1, 2017) that lists ten predictions without numbers; wording and casing are the copy's (for example 'it' for IT). IDC's own PDF link now redirects to a web page and has no Internet Archive copy. IDC document number not found.

entries.quote: By 2021, at Least 50% of Global GDP Will Be Digitized, with Growth in Every Industry Driven by Digitally Enhanced Offerings, Operations, and Relationships; by 2020, Investors Will Use Platform, Data Value, and Customer Engagement Metrics as Valuation Factors for All Enterprises
entries.subject: Digitized global GDP
entries.metric: share of global GDP digitized

entries.quote: By 2020, 60% of All Enterprises Will Have Fully Articulated an Organizationwide Digital Transformation Platform Strategy and Will Be in the Process of Implementing That Strategy as the New IT Core for Competing in the Digital Economy
entries.subject: Digital transformation platform strategy
entries.metric: share of enterprises with a fully articulated DX platform strategy

entries.quote: By 2021, Enterprises' Spending on Cloud Services and Cloud-Enabling Hardware, Software, and Services Will More than Double to Over $530 Billion, Leveraging the Diversifying Cloud Environment That Is 20% at the Edge, Over 15% Specialized (Non-x86) Compute, and Over 90% Multicloud
entries.subject: Cloud spending
entries.metric: enterprise spending on cloud services and cloud-enabling hardware, software and services
entries.note: Also: cloud environment 20% at the edge, over 15% non-x86, over 90% multicloud.

entries.quote: By 2019, 40% of Digital Transformation Initiatives Will Use AI Services; by 2021, 75% of Commercial Enterprise Apps Will Use AI, Over 90% of Consumers Will Interact with Customer Support Bots, and Over 50% of New Industrial Robots Will Leverage AI
entries.subject: AI in enterprise apps
entries.metric: share of digital transformation initiatives using AI services
entries.note: Also: by 2021, 75% of commercial enterprise apps use AI, over 90% of consumers interact with support bots, over 50% of new industrial robots leverage AI.

entries.quote: By 2021, Enterprise Apps Will Shift Toward Hyperagile Architectures, with 80% of Application Development on Cloud Platforms (PaaS) Using Microservices and Cloud Functions (e.g., AWS Lambda and Azure Functions) and Over 95% of New Microservices Deployed in Containers (e.g., Docker)
entries.subject: Microservices and serverless
entries.metric: share of application development on cloud platforms using microservices and cloud functions
entries.note: Also: over 95% of new microservices deployed in containers.

entries.quote: By 2020, Human-Digital Interfaces Will Diversify, as 25% of Field Service Techs and Over 25% of Info Workers Use Augmented Reality, Nearly 50% of New Mobile Apps Use Voice as a Primary Interface, and 50% of the Consumer-Facing G2000 Use Biometric Sensors to Personalize Experiences
entries.subject: AR, voice and biometric interfaces
entries.metric: share of field service techs using augmented reality
entries.note: Also: over 25% of info workers use AR, nearly 50% of new mobile apps use voice, 50% of consumer-facing G2000 use biometric sensors.

entries.quote: By 2021, at Least 25% of the G2000 Will Use Blockchain Services as a Foundation for Digital Trust at Scale; by 2020, 25% of Top Global Transaction Banks, Nearly 30% of Manufacturers and Retailers, and 20% of Healthcare Organizations Will Use Blockchain Networks in Production
entries.subject: Blockchain for digital trust
entries.metric: share of G2000 using blockchain services
entries.note: Also: by 2020, 25% of top transaction banks, nearly 30% of manufacturers and retailers, 20% of healthcare organizations use blockchain in production.

entries.quote: By 2020, 90% of Large Enterprises Will Generate Revenue from Data as a Service — from the Sale of Raw Data, Derived Metrics, Insights, and Recommendations — Up from Nearly 50% in 2017
entries.subject: Data as a service revenue
entries.metric: share of large enterprises generating revenue from data as a service

entries.quote: Improvements in Simple ("Low Code/No Code") Development Tools Will Dramatically Expand the Number of Nontech Developers Over the Next 36 Months; by 2021, These Nontraditional Developers Will Build 20% of Business Applications and 30% of New Application Features (60% by 2027)
entries.subject: Low-code developers
entries.metric: share of business applications built by nontraditional developers
entries.note: Also: 30% of new application features; 60% by 2027.

entries.quote: By 2021, More than Half of the G2000 Will See an Average of One-Third of Their Digital Services Interactions Come Through Their Open API Ecosystems, Up from Virtually 0% in 2017 — Amplifying Their Digital Reach Far Beyond Their Own Customer Interactions
entries.subject: Open API ecosystems
entries.metric: share of G2000 with one-third of digital services interactions through open API ecosystems

entries.quote: 75 percent of CIOs will put experiential engagement, data monetization, or digital business at scale at the top of their agenda by 2018.
entries.subject: Digital agenda priorities
entries.metric: share of CIOs with experiential engagement, data monetization or digital business at scale at top of agenda
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: 75 percent of CIOs and their enterprises will fail to meet all of their digital objectives through 2019, dragged down by conflicting digital transformation imperatives, ineffective technology innovation, cloud infrastructure transition, and underfunded end-of-life core systems.
entries.subject: Digital objectives shortfall
entries.metric: share of CIOs and enterprises failing to meet all digital objectives
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: 60 percent of the CIOs who have crossed the digital divide will prevail in c-suite turmoil and competition to become digital business leaders for their enterprises by 2020.
entries.subject: CIOs as digital business leaders
entries.metric: share of CIOs who crossed the digital divide prevailing as digital business leaders
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: 60 percent of CIOs will complete infrastructure and application re-platforming using cloud, mobile, and devops, clearing the deck for accelerated enterprise digital transformation by 2019.
entries.subject: Re-platforming
entries.metric: share of CIOs completing infrastructure and application re-platforming
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: 60 percent of it organizations will deploy DX platforms supporting new customer- and ecosystem-facing business models by 2019.
entries.subject: DX platforms
entries.metric: share of IT organizations deploying DX platforms
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: 75 percent of CIOs will refocus cybersecurity around authentication and trust to manage business risks, initiating the retirement of systems that cannot ensure data protection by 2019.
entries.subject: Authentication and trust in cybersecurity
entries.metric: share of CIOs refocusing cybersecurity on authentication and trust
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: 40 percent of CIOs will leverage vision- and mission-driven leadership to inspire and empower their organizations to create digital transformation capabilities by 2020.
entries.subject: Vision-driven leadership
entries.metric: share of CIOs using vision- and mission-driven leadership
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: 40 percent of CIOs will adopt new digital governance models to accelerate innovation and speed by 2019 recognizing the failure of existing it governance and the need for a shared digital transformation vision.
entries.subject: Digital governance models
entries.metric: share of CIOs adopting new digital governance models
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: 70 percent of CIOs will take agility to the next level, gearing up to a product model using design thinking and devops by 2018.
entries.subject: Product model with design thinking and DevOps
entries.metric: share of CIOs moving to a product model
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: 60 percent of CIOs will implement an it business model and culture that shifts focus from it projects to digitally-oriented products by 2020.
entries.subject: IT business model shift to products
entries.metric: share of CIOs shifting IT from projects to digitally oriented products
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.
